post_title: Emergency H1B Visa Appointment Denied at Hyderabad Consulate — Father Critical with Cancer — Feeling Completely Lost
concerns_or_questions_summary: Poster is in India for a critically ill father (advanced colon cancer) and needs H-1B stamping to return to the US, but the earliest regular slot at Hyderabad is in 2027. Their first emergency appointment request was denied despite a medical letter and employer/vendor support letters. They have one more chance to apply and are seeking advice to strengthen the second request.
